commits.message: flask-migrate, env-based config and sqlite hardening
commits.body:
- Add Flask-Migrate/Alembic with a baseline migration; create_app no longer
  calls db.create_all() — schema is managed by `flask db upgrade`.
- config.py: Development/Testing/Production config classes selected by
  FLASK_ENV, .env loaded via python-dotenv, Production refuses the default
  SECRET_KEY. Default DB path moved to instance/superlist.db.
- extensions.py: per-connection SQLite pragmas (WAL, foreign_keys=ON,
  synchronous=NORMAL); skips FK enforcement under Alembic batch migrations.
- models.py: explicit __tablename__, indexes, tz-aware timestamps,
  ondelete=CASCADE + passive_deletes, back_populates, Budget.current().
- run.py honours HOST/PORT/DEBUG from the environment.
- Add `flask init-db` and `flask import-history` CLI commands, .env.example,
  and ignore *.db / .env.

commits.message: apply the receipt theme to the app UI
commits.body:
Match the landing's look across the Flask app. Same two-ink palette
(ink + stamp purple) on warm paper over a dark counter, JetBrains Mono +
Special Elite, square edges, dashed/dotted rules and double lines, hard
offset shadows, die-cut sawtooth edges on the paper sheets.

- style.css: rewritten against the same class names — header bar, sidebar,
  shopping list (rows become dotted receipt lines, square check boxes),
  budget strip, history entries, comparator cards and results.
- _head.html: swap the Inter webfont for JetBrains Mono + Special Elite.

No template structure changes; all routes render.

commits.message: rework landing as a supermarket receipt
commits.body:
Full visual redesign of docs/. The page is now a single paper receipt on a
dark counter: monospaced type, die-cut notched edges, dotted price leaders,
ink stamps, a real Code 39 barcode, and a "TOTAL $0.00 / MIT" close.

- index.html: sections remapped to receipt anatomy (itemised detail = features,
  preparation instructions = install, pending items = roadmap, transaction
  history = changelog, totals block + footer).
- styles.css: rewritten. Two-ink palette (ink + stamp purple) on warm paper,
  CSS mask perforation, print-in reveal (respects prefers-reduced-motion),
  hard-shadow buttons, thermal-negative code blocks.
- script.js: live clock in the header and a back-to-top control.
- locale/es + locale/en: copy reworked to the receipt voice; 99 keys, parity verified.

fix(ci): set initial_tag so the first release bumps to v0.1.0

git-cliff --bumped-version produced '0.1.0' (no prefix) on a repo with no
tags, which fails validation against tag_pattern 'v[0-9]*' and broke the
release workflow. [bump] initial_tag pins the first version with the prefix.
